scene: Pocketing the brass key, you discover three ticket booths beside departing transports.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along the reef pier. On the far left sits a frosted sleigh tram with open doors. Left of centre stands the boy pocketing his shiny brass key. In the centre floats a tethered hot-air balloon with an open wicker basket. On the far right hangs a waiting hillside chairlift.
shown: A frosty sleigh tram idling on tracks on the far left
A striped hot-air balloon tethered to a post in the centre
A wooden chairlift swinging gently from a cable on the far right
